caption: The drawing shows a fabric artwork bordered with brown, pink, and blue stitching. Inside the rectangular frame, there is a girl standing on the left side, wearing a red hooded cape, a cream-colored dress with short brown sleeves, and a black or dark brown skirt underneath. She is holding a small rectangular basket or box, covered with a piece of cloth. At her feet, there is a small brown item that resembles a bag or pouch. To the right, there is a large gray wolf with a lighter underbelly, yellow eyes, and an open mouth showing its tongue; the wolf is facing the girl. The wolf's four legs are depicted in shades of yellow, orange, and pink, with embroidered lines outlining the limbs. Behind the wolf and extending to the upper right of the picture, there is a tree with a brown trunk and green, densely stitched foliage. The background consists of light blue and gray shades with embroidered swirls, and the entire composition is framed with decorative embroidery stitches.
title: Coverlet Detail (Red Riding Hood)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
